from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class ConstructionDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A single month of construction data extracted from a specific report release."""
    month: str = Field(description="The month the data applies to (YYYY-MM)")
    building_permits_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) for total building permits")
    housing_starts_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) for total housing starts")
    housing_completions_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) for total housing completions")
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="The date the report was released (YYYY-MM-DD) for precedence handling")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    data_points: list[ConstructionDataPoint]
